title: Rectitude Holdings Ltd. Announces SuperSun AIMS Battery Systems Listed Under Singapore Government's Energy Efficiency Grant
summary: Rectitude’s SS-250D and SS-500D SuperSun All-in-One Intelligence Micro-Grid (AIMS) Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) models are now listed under the Singapore Government’s Energy Efficiency Grant (EEG) for the construction sector. Eligible construction businesses in Singapore can receive grant support of up to 70% for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and up to 30% for non-SMEs. […]
body_markdown: Rectitude’s SS-250D and SS-500D SuperSun All-in-One Intelligence Micro-Grid (AIMS) Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) models are now listed under the Singapore Government’s Energy Efficiency Grant (EEG) for the construction sector. Eligible construction businesses in Singapore can receive grant support of up to 70% for Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and up to 30% for non-SMEs. \[…\]
